title: Small business or maker
summary: A practical storefront: explain what you offer, make shopping easy, then show products, visit details and custom enquiries.

notFor: Solo artists selling originals (start from artist)

cards.purpose: Say what the business makes or provides and where it operates.
The useful customer action: shop, order or book.
Three or four representative products with checked prices and practical details.
Confirmed opening hours, location and visit information.
Wholesale, custom work or service enquiries.

slots.ask: What name do you want at the top of the page?
slots.write: Exactly as they give it. Never shorten or translate it.

slots.ask: In one line, what do you do and for whom?
slots.write: One sentence, at most 120 characters, no hashtags or emoji. This appears in the About popover, not beside the name; repeat the essential purpose in the first text card.

slots.ask: Who is this page for, what do you make or offer, and what should a new visitor understand first?
slots.write: Use a short descriptive heading and two sentences: identify the person or group, the work and the audience. The header shows only the name; this card must explain the purpose. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Where do people buy from you, and what's new right now?
slots.write: Use a short heading describing the customer action or a confirmed current offer. First button = their shop, order or booking page; leave preset absent and use a clear label such as Visit the shop or Order now. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which three or four products best represent your work? For each: name, current price, one useful detail and a link. You can upload each photo in the editor.
slots.write: tag = price as on their shop; title = product name; description = size or one useful detail. Select up to four featured entries for this page; link to the complete archive or catalogue instead of deleting the person’s remaining work. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Can people visit you? When, and where?
slots.write: Hours and address exactly as they give them. A business address only; never a home address unless they say it is the shop. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What should people know before taking this action: who it is for, format, timing, price or reply expectations, only if you want to publish them?
slots.write: One or two short sentences, at most 400 characters. Include only facts supplied for this action; do not assume an introductory call is free or that any date, price or reply time is current. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you take wholesale or custom orders? Which address may be public?
slots.write: Email: Only an address they confirm may be public: everyone can see it. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: What short heading should introduce this action?
slots.write: Use a clear heading that describes the action; no unconfirmed availability or promise. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Which social accounts or marketplaces should be linked?
slots.write: Account URLs only. Use only their confirmed information; replace or remove every demonstration name, claim, number, price, quote, date and URL in this field. Never keep sample copy as a fallback.

slots.ask: Do you want a place on your profile? A city or region is enough.
slots.write: As they write it. Never infer it.

slots.ask: Do you have a website of your own?
Do you have a photo, artwork or logo you want to upload as the profile picture?
slots.write: The person uploads their chosen picture in the editor. Never fetch, generate or infer a personal photo. Use their description for alt text wherever the editor asks for it.
